name: Discord Notify
description: Posts a finished export's clip list to a Discord channel through a webhook. An example plugin.

exportActions.title: Post to Discord
exportActions.description: Posts the export's name and its clips to the channel.

commands.title: Send a test message to Discord

settings.title: Webhook URL
settings.description: From the channel's settings: Integrations, Webhooks, Copy Webhook URL. Kept in plain text: anyone with it can post to the channel.

settings.title: Posted as
settings.description: The name its posts show. Empty: the webhook's own name.

settings.title: List the clips
settings.description: Each clip's name and episode. Off: only how many there are.
